channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: 2 Minute Medicine Rewind August 31, 2026
item.description: A study in Japan found that the in-hospital mortality rate for patients undergoing elective atrial fibrillation ablation was low, but certain factors increased risk.

item.title: Clonal Hematopoiesis Tied to Brain Damage in AF
item.description: In atrial fibrillation patients, clonal hematopoiesis was associated with silent brain injury and faster cognitive decline over seven years, according to Medscape Medical News.

item.title: The Secret Weapon That Eliminated Doubt I Was a Good Doctor
item.description: A hematologist oncologist from a different cultural background shares how she discovered her inner strengths to succeed in medicine, overcoming self-doubt.

item.title: GCA Patients Stay on Steroids Beyond 48 Months
item.description: Despite guidelines aiming to stop glucocorticoids by 24 months in giant cell arteritis, about three-quarters of patients continue steroid therapy for longer.
